attempts.extent: Coordinate identities and their application to an attributed supplied witness. Plancherel/distributional Fourier foundations and witness existence remain identified inputs; no independent whole-construction or zeta-zero certificate follows.

attempts.brief: This route sought an exact connection between an incoming arithmetic heat map and incompressible velocity fields. The work constructed a solenoidal isometry, its inverse and complement, and retained nonlinear, pressure, forcing, and energy terms. A further angular-momentum calculation showed that the six-channel image has zero averaged swirl, placing the supplied witness’s reported swirl growth in the complement. The coordinate proofs were completed; source-witness existence remained attributed, with no new Navier–Stokes singularity or zeta-zero conclusion.

attempts.aim: Preserve fine quantum dynamics under repeated spatial blocking to test continuum spectral routes.
attempts.rationale: A coarse observable can retain the fine resolvent if eliminated variables return through an exact memory term.
attempts.rationale_basis: Source-based reconstruction from the proved mechanism.

attempts.outcome: Proved associative reconstruction and volume-independent bounds for large Wilson-loop spectral channels.
attempts.extent: Those channels keep a positive high-energy fraction at fixed coupling; this does not control every state's lowest energy.

attempts.brief: We wanted repeated spatial blocking to retain the fine quantum dynamics. The heuristic, reconstructed from the source, is that an exact memory term can preserve information in eliminated variables. Path maps, vacuum integrations and Schur complements gave associative reconstruction and volume-independent bounds for selected Wilson-loop channels. Those channels retain high-energy weight; the result does not determine every state's lowest energy or settle the continuum mass gap.

tasks.title: Erdős–Straus arithmetic routes
tasks.aim: Resolve Erdős–Straus and develop exact structural connections to other mathematics, preserving the original arithmetic rather than replacing it by a restricted selector.
tasks.broader_motivation: Arithmetic obstructions suggested connections to geometry, coloured structures and modular mathematics. Exact maps and their arithmetic return determine how far those connections work.
tasks.coverage: Five routes in the published supplement; not every historical task or neighbouring workbench.

attempts.title: Full-shell occupancy and factor sieves
attempts.aim: Determine exactly what an ES counterexample must evade.
attempts.rationale: Bounded prime-factor exponents retain information discarded by a coarse congruence sieve.
attempts.rationale_basis: Editorial reconstruction from cited constructions; broader aim recorded by source task.
attempts.tried: Full divisor packets, ordered witness reconstruction and exact factor tests for residuals three and seven.
attempts.outcome: Exact first-two-shell tests and a necessary-and-sufficient all-shell no-hit criterion at each input prime; explicit per-shell selector failures.
attempts.extent: The original full finite prime-shell system, with complete fibres; the first-two-shell criterion concerns those shells only. No proof that some shell is occupied for every prime, and no prime with all shells empty.
attempts.brief: We wanted to identify exactly what an ES counterexample would evade. The reconstructed heuristic was that bounded factor exponents retain information coarse congruences lose. Full divisor packets and factor tests gave exact first-two-shell tests and a primewise all-shell criterion. We have neither established occupancy at every prime nor found a prime with all shells empty.

attempts.title: Simultaneous constraints and bounded CRT
attempts.aim: Express the colleague's linked conditions on one exact permitted integer tuple.
attempts.rationale: CRT can organize congruences if shared variables and their original bounds survive the local-to-global passage.
attempts.rationale_basis: Editorial reconstruction from cited constructions; broader aim recorded by source task.
attempts.tried: Lattice gluing, bounded divisor CRT, Boolean coordinates and bounded input/prime-output incidence.
attempts.outcome: Complete finite fibre algorithms and witness return; exact examples of integral and finite-budget obstructions.
attempts.extent: All solutions in the specified original finite domains, with their exact input/output projections. Integral compatibility does not by itself give bounded occupancy; the prime-output construction has no asserted surjectivity.
attempts.brief: We wanted linked congruences to hold on one tuple inside its original bounds. The reconstructed heuristic was that CRT could organize them while preserving shared variables. Lattice, bounded-divisor and incidence calculations gave complete finite fibres and explicit obstructions. Integral compatibility still does not force a bounded solution, and the prime-output map is not known to be onto.

attempts.title: Witness propagation and exact first codes
attempts.aim: Propagate solutions with their order, raw factor scale and original codes retained.
attempts.rationale: A transport law can connect witnesses across shells or primes without restarting their construction.
attempts.rationale_basis: Editorial reconstruction from cited constructions; broader aim recorded by source task.
attempts.tried: Ratio maps, positive shears, fixed-denominator successors, ray returns and four swap/tag candidates.
attempts.outcome: Complete integer domains, inverse maps and failed returns; a global first code on the occupied residual-three domain.
attempts.extent: Each explicitly classified transport domain; the residual-three first-code theorem applies when that shell is occupied. The classified domains do not yet force universal occupancy. Two passing adjacent positive shears cannot compose.
attempts.brief: We tried to propagate solutions with their order, factor scale and codes retained. The reconstructed rationale was that exact transport might replace repeated searches. Ratio maps, shears and returns yielded classified integer domains and a first code on occupied residual-three shells. Universal occupancy remains unresolved; in particular, two passing adjacent positive shears cannot compose.

Intersections, returns, primitive marks and an affine correction produced exact maps with recoverable arithmetic. attempts.title: Recover data hidden by trivial-zero cancellation
attempts.aim: Find where higher radial information goes when a zeta factor cancels its Mellin pole.
attempts.rationale: A cancelled pole need not mean that the input coefficient has disappeared.
attempts.rationale_basis: reconstructed_from_written_argument

attempts.brief: We asked where radial data goes when a zeta factor cancels its Mellin pole. The reconstructed heuristic was that cancelling a pole need not erase the coefficient. Expanding the full product recovered odd Taylor coefficients from residues and even ones from regular values using the multiplier derivative. This recovers the Taylor sequence, not an arbitrary smooth germ; flat remainders remain in the full transform.

The full coefficient recursion retained pressure, viscosity and cutoff terms and passed into residue/value coordinates.
